'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Sri Lankan presidential election]]
**For the first time in [[Sri Lanka]]'s history, election officials begin a second round of vote counting. In the first round, [[National People's Power]] candidate [[Anura Kumara Dissanayake]] led with 42.31% of the vote counted, while [[Leader of the Opposition (Sri Lanka)|opposition leader]] and [[Samagi Jana Balawegaya|United People's Power]] candidate [[Sajith Premadasa]] took second place with 32.76%. Incumbent [[President of Sri Lanka|President]] [[Ranil Wickremesinghe]] came in third place with 17% of the vote. Following the counting of second and third preferences, Dissanayake is declared president-elect by the [[Election Commission of Sri Lanka|election commission]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-presidential-election-dissanayake-wickremesinghe-results-50a8990acae90fabaddd8d01c0ef5bcd (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyznjz3d78o (BBC News)]
*The [[United Nations]] adopts the "''Pact for the Future''", aiming for [[multilateralism|multilateral]] cooperative work towards peace and security, [[global governance]], [[climate change]], [[sustainable development]], [[human rights]], and more. [https://www.reuters.com/world/un-adopts-pact-that-aims-save-global-cooperation-2024-09-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Researchers from the [[University of Cape Town]] and the [[Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology]] announce they have [[genome project|reconstructed]] the oldest [[human genome]] ever found, belonging to a man and a woman who lived about 10,000 years ago in the [[Mesolithic|Mesolithic period]]. The prior oldest decoded genome was from about 2,000 years ago. [https://www.dw.com/en/oldest-human-dna-from-south-africa-decoded/a-70296208 (DW)]
